meta.title: DamaDojo — checkers that teach you to think
meta.description: A premium platform for Russian checkers with AI bots and a full game review tool. Train your strategic thinking every day.

hero.subtitle: Face Ata, Zhanar or Temir. Get a full post-game review with every move classified. Tomorrow, the critical moment returns as your daily puzzle.

ata.name: Ata
ata.title: The calm aksakal
ata.bio: A patient old-school player. Never rushes, calculates several moves ahead. Perfect when you're learning.

zhanar.name: Zhanar
zhanar.title: Young, fast
zhanar.bio: Energetic style with active captures. Loves a sharp tempo and unexpected combinations.

temir.name: Temir
temir.title: The strict master
temir.bio: A laconic opponent whose calculation has no weak points. Sit down with Temir only if you're ready.
